description: Registry of user-facing touchpoints for the E2E safety net. A touchpoint is 'covered' when its id appears as an @id tag in a spec title under tests/e2e. A preload channel with no journey must be an untestedChannels object with a reason and an added date no older than 21 UTC days. Reconciled and gated by scripts/e2e-touchpoints.cjs.

critical.label: Money movement, data integrity, and authentication

touchpoints.description: First-run: create master password, acknowledge recovery key, reach app shell
Returning user unlocks the vault with the master password
An incorrect master password keeps the app locked
Locking the app returns to the login screen
Create and open a named budget from the picker
Add an income source, save the draft, and confirm it persists across reload
An unsaved draft income is dropped on reload
Submitting with required fields empty keeps the form open
Script-like source name renders as inert text (no script execution)
Savings-and-goals-only income is excluded from spendable totals and appears as a non-spendable deposit on the schedule
Add a due-date bill, save, and confirm it persists across reload
Delete a saved bill, save, and confirm it stays gone after reload
A per-paycheck bill cannot be saved without an income source
Income + bills produce a rendered paycheck schedule
Raise one bill occurrence above its series amount, save, and reset it without changing the series
In-app navigation is unguarded: switching pages preserves the draft so users can simulate uncommitted changes freely
Lock App never prompts: privacy lock preserves the mid-edit draft across unlock
Exit guard (Quit / window close): Cancel keeps you in the app with the draft intact
Exit guard (Quit / window close): Discard All drops the draft and proceeds
Exit guard (Quit / window close): Save All Changes persists the draft and proceeds
Native window close with dirty draft: Cancel keeps the app open and the draft intact
Native window close with dirty draft: Discard All exits the app
Native window close with dirty draft: Save All Changes persists then exits
Native window close with a clean draft exits without prompting
Script-like creditor name renders as inert text
Create a savings goal, save, and confirm it persists across reload
Create button stays disabled until name, amount, and date are valid
Script-like goal name renders as inert text
Add Debt is disabled until a Debt-category bill exists
Track a debt bill, save, and confirm it persists with amortization
No income/bills shows the empty schedule state
The schedule View selector offers a per-goal 'Through <goal>' term option that re-slices the schedule
An underfunded goal surfaces an at-risk indicator on the Schedule 'Goals Total' summary cell
A tight budget surfaces negative budget remaining on a paycheck
Reconciliation never proposes skipping a bill as an automatic fix
Optional income end date is saved and shortens projected paychecks
Every sidebar route renders without a stuck loading spinner
Dashboard overview renders
Summary page renders
Budgets management page renders
Export page renders
Export the schedule to a PDF through the save dialog and confirm the file is written
Settings page renders
Edit an existing bill (not yet covered by a journey; delete is bills.delete)
Edit and delete an existing goal (not yet covered by a journey)

untestedChannels.reason: No screen calls this. Exit behavior listens for a close request instead of reading an OS string.
No screen calls this. The picker and Budgets page load budgets through budget:get-all-with-stats.
No screen calls this. Income and bill counts arrive inside budget:get-all-with-stats.
No journey renames a budget or saves cash targets or the schedule start date.
No journey deletes a budget from the Budgets page and confirms it is gone.
No journey starts a Quick Budget. The suite always creates and opens a named budget.
No journey ends a Quick Budget, because no journey starts one.
No journey unlocks with Touch ID or Windows Hello. Headless runs cannot complete a biometric prompt, and login tests use the master password.
The harness declines the keychain save prompt, so no journey has a saved password to unlock with.
When setup offers fingerprint enrollment, the journey clicks Skip for now instead of enabling it. Headless CI often has no biometric device.
No journey changes the master password from Settings and acknowledges the new recovery key.
No screen calls this. Setup shows the recovery key returned by auth:create-master-password.
No journey submits a recovery key on the login screen.
No journey resets the master password with a recovery key.
Layout sends this only after 30 seconds of pointer or keyboard input, and no journey waits for that heartbeat.

No journey deletes an existing income source and confirms it stays gone after reload.
No journey edits an existing bill. That action remains the planned bills.edit touchpoint.
